listing.name: Monster Hunter Freedom Unite — MHFU-PC (Kiridor123)
listing.summary: Pokke uses native ahead-of-time compilation with Vulkan and SDL3. Gameplay and save reports are the project’s claims. MHForever uses a different European source edition. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA ULUS10391 v1.01 ISO.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use Pokke.exe from Releases with your own ISO. The Linux AppImage build generates the game locally.

warnings: Pokke uses native ahead-of-time compilation with Vulkan and SDL3. Gameplay and save reports are the project’s claims. MHForever uses a different European source edition.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
